name: Copenhagen Business School
about: CBS is a single-subject university: everything it teaches is business, economics or something deliberately bolted onto business — sociology, politics, philosophy, shipping. It has about 21,000 students on one compact campus in Frederiksberg, a tram ride from central Copenhagen, and roughly one student in five is international. Six of its fifteen bachelor programmes are taught in English and they are among the hardest degrees in Denmark to get into on grades alone: in 2026 the quota 1 cut-off for International Business was 11.1 out of a maximum 12.
ibNotes: CBS accepts the IB Diploma as equivalent to a Danish upper secondary exam only if it has at least 24 points including bonus and minus penalty points, at least 6 subjects, at least 3 and no more than 4 subjects at Higher Level, a submitted Extended Essay, a completed Theory of Knowledge course and all CAS activities completed.
The IB Diploma is a convertible exam at CBS, so you are assessed in both quota 1 and quota 2. Your total points are converted to the Danish scale using the Ministry's conversion table.

Grade conversion for single subjects is blunt and worth memorising: CBS states "Danish grade 2.0 = local grade 3" and "Danish grade 6.0 = local grade 5". Every English-taught programme requires English B with a minimum grade of 6.0, so in practice you need at least a 5 in your IB English subject.

CBS's IB results-service institution code is 000151. If you finish your IB in the year you apply, this is the only route CBS accepts: "please ask your IB Coordinator to grant CBS ('Copenhagen Business School (000151)) access to your online IB results." Tell your coordinator shortly after the May exams; CBS retrieves the results on 5 July.

The language requirement of English A is met by IB English B (HL), English A1, English A2, English A Language and Literature, or English A Literature, at SL or HL. English B at SL meets the specific entry requirement of English B but not the English A language requirement.

Mathematics A is met by any IB Mathematics at HL; Mathematics B by any IB Mathematics at SL or HL. Social Studies B is met by Business management, Economics, Global Politics or History at SL or HL, or by Geography HL or Social and cultural anthropology HL.
IB Diploma Programme Course Results (certificates) are convertible but do not on their own meet the general entry requirement.
quotaNotes: CBS allocates roughly 70 per cent of places in quota 1 and 30 per cent in quota 2, but the split is set per programme and for the English-taught degrees it is usually 60/40 (50/50 for Shipping and Trade). Quota 1 is purely the converted grade point average, ranked in descending order until places run out. Quota 2 is an overall assessment of three things: a motivational essay for the programmes where one counts, activities completed after your upper secondary exam (maximum 12 months, relevance is not assessed), and your grades in the specific entry requirement subjects. All six English-taught bachelor programmes count a motivational essay in quota 2. There is a trap for school-leavers: CBS states that "Your motivational essay will only be included in the overall assessment if, by the Quota 2 deadline, a minimum of three months has passed since the completion of your upper secondary education." A May 2027 IB candidate applying on 15 March 2027 has not yet finished school, so the essay cannot help them — the essay is aimed at gap-year applicants.

deadlines.label: Application (holders of an international upper secondary exam, including IB) — quota 1 and quota 2
deadlines.notes: CBS's deadline table gives 15 March 12.00 CET for both quota 1 and quota 2 if your exam is international. This is earlier than the 5 July quota 1 deadline that applies to holders of a Danish upper secondary exam. The portal optagelse.dk opens on 1 February.

deadlines.label: Motivational essay and quota 2 activity documentation
deadlines.notes: Uploaded to optagelse.dk as a PDF whose file name contains the words "Motivational Essay". One essay per programme, written in English for English-taught programmes. Essays uploaded after the deadline are not assessed.

deadlines.label: Documentation of entry requirements (diploma and transcripts)
deadlines.notes: CBS: "Starting with the 2027 admission round, for applicants who have completed their upper secondary education by the application deadline (15 March 2027, 12.00 noon CET), the deadline for uploading official documentation for the upper secondary qualifications … is 15 March 2027, 12.00 noon CET." A May 2027 IB candidate has not completed the exam by 15 March, so 5 July applies — and for them CBS retrieves the results through IBIS rather than by upload.

deadlines.label: All deadlines for non-EU/EEA citizens needing a residence permit
deadlines.notes: Application, documentation, motivational essay and the EUR 150 application fee must all be in by 15 March 12.00 CET. In practice this means a non-EU applicant cannot apply with results that only arrive in July.

deadlines.label: Answer to your application and publication of quota 1 cut-offs
deadlines.notes: CBS publishes the minimum grade point average needed for admission on 28 July, after selection has finished.

deadlines.label: Tuition fee payment for the first semester (non-EU/EEA)
deadlines.notes: The residence permit process only starts once the first semester's tuition is cleared in CBS's account, and can take up to two months.

tuitionNonEu: EUR 6,500 per semester (EUR 13,000 per year), or DKK 49,000 per semester (DKK 98,000 per year), for bachelor programmes. Application fee EUR 150 (approximately DKK 1,125) per applicant per admission round, payable by 15 March at 12.00 CET. EU/EEA and Swiss citizens pay neither.

notes: A, B and C are Danish subject levels, not grades. The minimum grade of 6.0 attached to English B (and to Mathematics B on the Sociology programme) is a grade on the Danish 7-point scale, and corresponds to an IB subject grade of 5 under CBS's own conversion.
CBS does not round up: "If you have passed a subject with an average grade of 5.5 on the Danish scale and the grade requirement is 6.0, you do not meet the requirement. We do not round grades up."

A subject passed at A level automatically satisfies a 6.0 grade requirement at B level in that subject. So IB Mathematics HL clears the Mathematics B minimum 6.0 requirement on the Sociology programme regardless of the grade.

Every English-taught programme has two English hurdles: the specific entry requirement of English B with a minimum grade of 6.0, and the separate language requirement of English A. Most IB English subjects clear both, but English B at Standard Level clears only the first.

All six English-taught programmes count a motivational essay in the quota 2 assessment — but only for applicants who finished school at least three months before the quota 2 deadline. Read the quotaNotes before planning around it.

CBS's English-taught portfolio has shrunk. BSc in International Business in Asia (Chinese) and BSc in International Business in Asia (Japanese) appear in CBS's own admission figures for 2023 and 2024 and have gone by 2026. CBS's policy page states that "As a general rule, CBS establishes all programmes it offers but may choose to depart from this principle in cases where dimensioning requirements and financial considerations carry greater weight." Programme closure, rather than a cut to the size of each intake, is how dimensioning has shown up here so far: study places on the surviving English-taught degrees were flat or slightly up between 2022 and 2026.

Applications keep rising. Between 2025 and 2026 total applications rose 23 per cent for International Business, 27 per cent for International Business and Politics and 32 per cent for International Shipping and Trade, so the 2026 cut-offs should be read as a floor rather than a forecast.
CBS teaches on one campus around Solbjerg Plads in Frederiksberg. There is no second city to consider.
The TOEFL institutional code for CBS is 7035 if you need a language test instead of a qualifying English subject.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Digital Management
programmes.summary: A business degree for people who want to be the person in the room who understands both the spreadsheet and the system. About a third is economics and mathematics, a third IT and technology, the rest organisation, management and the social context of digital change. You will do some programming and a lot of data analysis, but this is a management degree, not a computer science degree.
programmes.requirementsText: Specific entry requirements: English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. Mathematics level B. History level B or International Economics level B or Social Studies level B or History of Ideas level B or Contemporary History level B. Language requirement: English level A. You must fulfil both the specific entry requirements and the language requirement to be eligible for the programme.
extraRequirements: Motivational essay counts in the quota 2 assessment, but only if at least three months have passed since you completed your upper secondary education by the quota 2 deadline.
210 study places in 2026, split 60 per cent quota 1 and 40 per cent quota 2. 2,210 applications in 2026, up 24 per cent on 2025.
Admission area number on optagelse.dk: 13100.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Service Management
programmes.summary: Standard business economics — marketing, operations, finance, strategy — applied to industries that sell experiences and services rather than objects: tourism, culture, hospitality, digital services. You pick one of three specialisations later on: Culture and Tourism, Managing Digital Services, or Service Innovation. It is the least competitive of the six English-taught CBS degrees on 2026 figures.
programmes.requirementsText: Specific entry requirements: English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. Mathematics level B. History level B or International Economics level B or Social Studies level B or History of Ideas level B or Contemporary History level B. Language requirement: English level A. You must fulfil both the specific entry requirements and the language requirement to be eligible for the programme.
extraRequirements: Motivational essay counts in the quota 2 assessment, subject to the three-month rule.
170 study places in 2026, split 70 per cent quota 1 and 30 per cent quota 2. 1,596 applications in 2026, up 22 per cent on 2025.
Admission area number on optagelse.dk: 13080.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Sociology
programmes.summary: Business economics taught alongside sociology and philosophy, so that you spend as much time on why a company behaves the way it does as on what it earns. Roughly a third of the content is philosophy and sociology, a quarter economics and mathematics, a quarter organisation and management. Only 100 places, and the one CBS English-taught degree that also demands a minimum grade in Mathematics.
programmes.requirementsText: Specific entry requirements: English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. Mathematics level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. History level B or International Economics level B or Social Studies level B or History of Ideas level B or Contemporary History level B. Language requirement: English level A. You must fulfil both the specific entry requirements and the language requirement to be eligible for the programme.
extraRequirements: Mathematics B must be passed with a minimum grade of 6.0 on the Danish scale, which is an IB grade of 5. IB Mathematics at HL satisfies this automatically, because a subject passed at A level fulfils any B-level grade requirement.
Motivational essay counts in the quota 2 assessment, subject to the three-month rule.
100 study places in 2026, split 60 per cent quota 1 and 40 per cent quota 2. 1,234 applications in 2026.
Admission area number on optagelse.dk: 13075.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.summary: The broad business economics degree — strategy, finance, marketing, organisation — with everything framed around companies operating across borders. About half the compulsory courses use mathematics as a working tool, at roughly the level of the entry requirement. It is the most applied-to and the highest cut-off of any CBS bachelor, and a third of the students are non-Danish.
programmes.requirementsText: Specific entry requirements: English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. Mathematics level B. History level B or International Economics level B or Social Studies level B or History of Ideas level B or Contemporary History level B. Language requirement: English level A. You must fulfil both the specific entry requirements and the language requirement to be eligible for the programme.
extraRequirements: Motivational essay counts in the quota 2 assessment, subject to the three-month rule.
245 study places in 2026, split 60 per cent quota 1 and 40 per cent quota 2. 3,069 applications in 2026, up 23 per cent on 2025.
The cut-off has been 11.1 or higher every year since 2023 (11.5 in 2023, 11.4 in 2024, 11.1 in 2025 and 2026).
Admission area number on optagelse.dk: 13060.
Two tri-continental exchange options, TREBLE and Global SCLM, are open to enrolled students by competitive application in the first semester; they are not part of the admission process.

programmes.name: International Business and Politics
programmes.summary: Half political science, half economics and mathematics, built around the question of how firms operate when regulation, trade policy and geopolitics keep moving. Roughly 40 per cent politics, 40 per cent economics and mathematics, with smaller blocks on trade and logistics and on organisation. Pick it if you would be equally happy reading a trade agreement and a balance sheet.

programmes.name: International Shipping and Trade
programmes.summary: A small, highly structured degree about the industry that moves physical goods: shipping markets, chartering, maritime law, logistics and trade finance. The second year includes a compulsory semester abroad in Singapore, Hong Kong or Greece, and the final year includes a compulsory internship in a shipping company. Only 75 places, and half of them are decided in quota 2.
programmes.requirementsText: Specific entry requirements: English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. Mathematics level B. History level B or International Economics level B or Social Studies level B or History of Ideas level B or Contemporary History level B. Language requirement: English level A. You must fulfil both the specific entry requirements and the language requirement to be eligible for the programme.
extraRequirements: Compulsory exchange semester in year two and a compulsory internship in a shipping company in year three.
Motivational essay counts in the quota 2 assessment, subject to the three-month rule. With a 50/50 quota split this programme puts more weight on quota 2 than any other CBS bachelor.
75 study places in 2026, split 50 per cent quota 1 and 50 per cent quota 2. 1,189 applications in 2026, up 32 per cent on 2025.
